NASH-101.title: Add Task creation flow should work end-to-end
NASH-101.description:
As a user, I want to add a new task so I can track my work.

Given the task tracker is loaded
When I enter a task title and click "Add Task"
Then the task appears in the task list

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /tasks creates a task and returns 201
- The new task appears in GET /tasks
- The UI "Add Task" button adds the task to the visible list

Automation notes: earlier smoke-test automation targeted the button by id #add-task-btn. Confirm this still locates the button before relying on it.
